description:
What this is. One record per employee per day, saying whether they were in. Most are written for you from the scans; this is where you add or correct one by hand when a machine missed somebody — a failed scan, a flat battery, a person working away from their usual gate. Without it they show as absent even though they worked.

What to do. Open the list to see the days already recorded, and add one for anybody who is missing. To fix several people at once, Attendance Insights has a Actions tab that marks a whole group for a date, or a range of dates, and lets you give a reason — away assignment, pending off, pending holiday — so a corrected day can be told apart from one the machines recorded.

Where to find it. Attendance, under HR.
name: Mark Attendance for Missed Scans
title: Attendance — marking a day the machine missed
